properties.evidence: The earlier one saw this coming. That accepted requirement asks for nesting 'as deep as the design needs' — and 'as the design needs' is precisely the quantity span of control computes, rather than the open-ended invitation it has been read as. Its own measurement already flagged 'DEPTH IS TWO, not as deep as the design needs' as the shortfall; a fan-out rule is what would say how deep is actually needed instead of leaving it to judgement.
